info.title: NOTAM Schedule API
info.description: NOTAMs (AISWEB/DECEA no Brasil, FAA NMS-API no exterior): fechamentos de pista por aeroporto, todos os NOTAMs e checagem de voos.

get.description: Liveness check. Does not call the AISWEB or the FAA.

Runway NOTAMs active in the window, per airport, with closure type, periods and confidence.

Brazilian airports come from the AISWEB; the others from the FAA NMS-API (when the server has its
credentials). Airports without a source or whose query failed come back with status out_of_coverage/error:
that means there is NO DATA for them, not that they have no restriction.

post.description:
For each flight leg, the closures that apply to that operation within ±margin of its time.

Combines every closure at the airport: `no_runway` is true when, at some moment of the window, all
runways published in ROTAER are closed (then `severity` is CRITICAL even if each NOTAM alone is not).
A landing-only closure does not restrict departures, and vice versa.

timezone.title: Timezone

status.title: Status

runways.title: Runways
runways.description: Runways published in ROTAER (Brazil only; empty for FAA airports)

other_notams.title: Other Notams
other_notams.description: Only with include_other=true: every non-runway NOTAM

run.description: Run whose changes are shown (default: the latest)

previous.description: Run it is compared with; null = first run, nothing to compare

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Most recent runs, to pick another one

type.title: Type
type.description: conditional = operations may be authorised with prior coordination / PPR

exception.title: Exception
exception.description: The EXC clause of the NOTAM, e.g. 'INT RWY 03/21'

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: What lowered (or supports) the score, in Portuguese

page.title: Page
page.description: The digest as a web page (Excel link inside)

feed.title: Feed
feed.description: RSS feed that Power Automate reads

DigestInfo.title: DigestInfo
DigestInfo.description: A NOTAM digest (the e-mail sent to the analysts through the RSS feed).

international.title: International
international.description: Whether NOTAMs outside Brazil (FAA NMS-API) are enabled

time.title: Time
time.description: STD/STA in UTC; null = flight without time (whole day)

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Last query failed: its NOTAMs may be out of date

time.title: Time
time.description: STD for departures, STA for arrivals. Without offset = UTC

active_periods.title: Active Periods
active_periods.description: Active periods overlapping the leg window

confidence.description: Confidence of this NOTAM for this leg (includes timing)

restricted.title: Restricted
restricted.description: At least one closure applies to this operation in the window

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Worst severity for the leg (CRITICAL when no runway is left)

no_runway.title: No Runway
no_runway.description: At some moment of the window every published runway is closed

open_runways.title: Open Runways
open_runways.description: Runways with no closure in the window; null = runways unknown (no ROTAER)

qcode.title: Qcode
qcode.description: Q-code letters without the leading Q (subject + condition)

OtherNotam.title: OtherNotam
OtherNotam.description: A NOTAM that is not a runway restriction (taxiway, lights, navaids, obstacles, airspace...).

by.title: By
by.description: Who read it (name shown to the team)

margin_minutes.title: Margin Minutes
margin_minutes.description: Window before and after the leg time; 0 = only the leg time itself

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Severity of the NOTAM on its own

closure.description: Present for runway and aerodrome closures

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Item D as published (weekdays are UTC days)

schedule_understood.title: Schedule Understood
schedule_understood.description: false: item D not parsed, NOTAM treated as active all the time

active_periods.title: Active Periods
active_periods.description: When the NOTAM is active inside the requested window

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: Same NOTAM published in another language

impacts.title: Impacts
impacts.description: Flight x NOTAM impacts (at most 2000, most severe first)

errors.title: Errors
